baseline_definitions.historical_mean: mean of effective training primary y only

dependency_policy: Require Stage13.2 source/graph evidence and no used Volume dependency for the nine+three market representations; only exact market X columns can reach scalers; changed upstream hashes fail closed
fold_win_definition: strict delta < 0; exact ties are not wins
formal_prediction_policy: One immutable fold×model×date prediction set; debug/repro runs must produce identical formal bytes
limitations: Single ticker; overlapping 5d labels and successive expanding fits are dependent
Historical Stage11/12 development findings already known; Stage14 is a frozen follow-up, not an independent Final Test
Labels may end in inherited pre-test gap; no gap feature rows used
Stage13.2 acquisition metadata limitations and Volume-use restrictions remain unchanged

predictive_success_rules.ambiguity_resolution: Use the explicit numeric conditions in sections 40/42/43 in that order; illustrative examples in section 44 do not override numeric NO_ROBUST predicate.
classification_precedence: ROBUST if either Relative model passes all six
NO_ROBUST if neither Relative model simultaneously passes both mean-fold baseline wins and both strict majority fold wins
predictive_success_rules.model_robust: All six: mean-fold MAE beats zero and historical_mean; median fold delta vs each <0; strict fold win rate vs each >0.50

preprocessing_order: exact zero-variance removal on imputed effective train
purge_rule: Training feature date < first observed validation session; entry/exit observed-source oracle; 5d exit must be strictly before first observed validation session. Ordinary folds use 5d; frozen final pre-gap is not shortened.
range_denominator: Non-null raw validation feature values; strict below/above raw effective-train min/max; equality within

SMA_mechanism_support: median across folds of SMA-group max|z| is strictly lower for Relative
equal-weight mean fold SMA out-of-range fraction is strictly lower for Relative
strict majority of folds have lower Relative SMA max|z|
mean fold SMA fraction |z|>5 is no higher for Relative
classification_precedence: NO_BROAD if neither family has majority MAE improvement OR new_systematic_pathology
BROAD if both have majority MAE improvement AND all SMA mechanism support gates AND no new_systematic_pathology
representation_success_rules.fold_MAE_support: Relative vs Original strict fold win rate >0.50 for BOTH OLS and Ridge
representation_success_rules.mechanism_unit: One paired fold×representation exposure per feature, not duplicated across OLS/Ridge; selected features use actual training scaler and train-imputed validation values
representation_success_rules.new_systematic_pathology: Either severe extrapolation or severe-prediction predicate
representation_success_rules.operationalization_reason: Freeze quantitative meaning of overall mechanism direction/systematic pathology before any Stage14 results; use prompt diagnostic thresholds 5 and 0.20 plus its majority semantics, no threshold search
representation_success_rules.systematic_severe_extrapolation: Strict majority of folds where Relative SMA max|z|>5 and >Original, AND Relative SMA fraction |z|>5 >Original
representation_success_rules.systematic_severe_predictions: For either family, strict majority of folds where Relative fraction |prediction|>0.20 >Original AND Relative max|prediction|>Original AND Relative max|prediction|>0.20

reproducibility_policy: Two consecutive offline formal runs; every authoritative CSV/JSON byte-identical; runtime/test logs and post-run execution_verification separate; no current timestamps in formal files
row_eligibility_policy: Target date/provenance availability only; do not globally drop missing X or sparse fundamentals. Missing/invalid labels or authorized nonfinite features fail loudly and are audited; no silent row removal.
secondary_target_policy: Date/provenance-only for inherited boundary checks; never numerical labels, predictions or model metrics
stage_name: Stage 14 — Pre-Registered Multi-Year Walk-Forward Validation of Relative Market Linear Models
target_definition: Close[t+5] / Open[t+1] - 1 using observed session positions
validation_label_policy: Every declared development validation session retains its canonical 5d label and provenance. Labels may realize in the frozen pre-test gap but must end strictly before Final Test. Gap sessions are never training/validation feature observations; frozen labels are not recomputed using a truncated price window.
yearly_diagnostics: 2021–2026 development only; descriptive; cannot drive selection or regime rules
